title: Butter bean and sprout pie with pumpkin mash

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a whole food or a plain staple, and vegetable stock and crème fraîche are acceptable.

supermarket.reason: Pumpkin, sprouts, leeks, tinned butter beans and cheddar are all everyday Tesco items in October.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a saucepan, a frying pan, a masher and a baking dish, with simple boiling, softening and baking.

works.reason: Two tins of beans with sprouts, leeks and 1kg pumpkin mash make a sensible pie for four, and the oven temperature and timings are given.

honest_times.reason: Thirty minutes covers peeling the pumpkin, trimming the sprouts and leeks, frying and mashing, and the 15-minute boil plus 25-minute bake match the 40 cook minutes.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including nutmeg and sage, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm pie topped with pumpkin mash suits early October, and the pumpkin forms a substantial topping named in the title.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a filling vegetable and bean pie with a cheese-topped mash that a family would happily eat again.
